Vulnerability Management

Validação de Conformidade

The systematic confirmation that cryptographic, PKI, and supporting systems conform to relevant standards, policies, and regulatory requirements such as NIST, ISO/IEC, and ETSI.

Quick answer: The systematic confirmation that cryptographic, PKI, and supporting systems conform to relevant standards, policies, and regulatory requirements such as NIST, ISO/IEC, and ETSI.

Quick answer

The systematic confirmation that cryptographic, PKI, and supporting systems conform to relevant standards, policies, and regulatory requirements such as NIST, ISO/IEC, and ETSI.

Why it matters

Validação de Conformidade matters because it supports clear communication in Vulnerability Management contexts for SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and Incident Responders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and CEH.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Validação de Conformidade?

In this glossary, Validação de Conformidade refers to: The systematic confirmation that cryptographic, PKI, and supporting systems conform to relevant standards, policies, and regulatory requirements such as NIST, ISO/IEC, and ETSI.

How is Validação de Conformidade used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A validação de conformidade de todos os componentes PKI é exigida anualmente para garantir o alinhamento contínuo com FIPS 140-3 e ISO/IEC 19790."

Why does Validação de Conformidade matter in cybersecurity?

Validação de Conformidade matters because it supports clear communication in Vulnerability Management contexts for SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and Incident Responders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and CEH.

Who uses Validação de Conformidade?

Validação de Conformidade is mainly used by SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and Incident Responders.

What category does Validação de Conformidade belong to?

In this glossary, Validação de Conformidade is grouped under Vulnerability Management. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The systematic confirmation that cryptographic, PKI, and supporting systems conform to relevant standards, policies, and regulatory requirements such as NIST, ISO/IEC, and ETSI.

Operational example
